recipes.oracle_text: Counter target spell unless its controller pays {1}. Scry 1. (Look at the top card of your library. You may put that card on the bottom.)

recipe_coverage: Oracle-reviewed counterspell component through real casting and priority: own/opposing spells, supported type/color/value restrictions, payment, no stack, insufficient mana, ordered destinations and immediate effects, populated-zone snapshot replay. Tax counters also cover pay, decline, exact mana, and unaffordable payment. Counter immunity, target removal during response, multiple stack objects, and exceptional card types require separate cases.
